digest: A single VPN authentication failure for user m.alvarez was immediately followed by a successful MFA-confirmed login from the same registered corporate device and usual home IP address. This pattern is consistent with a user mistyping their password. No malicious activity was observed.

evidence_findings.title: VPN Authentication Failure
evidence_findings.subject: m.alvarez
evidence_findings.evidence: A VPN authentication attempt for user m.alvarez from IP 198.51.100.24 failed at approximately 2026-08-17T08:03Z.
evidence_findings.conclusion: This indicates an initial unsuccessful login attempt, likely due to user error.

evidence_findings.title: Successful MFA-Confirmed VPN Login
evidence_findings.subject: m.alvarez
evidence_findings.evidence: A successful MFA-confirmed VPN login for user m.alvarez from IP 198.51.100.24 occurred at approximately 2026-08-17T08:04Z, originating from the user's registered laptop and usual home address.
evidence_findings.conclusion: This confirms legitimate access shortly after the failure, secured by multi-factor authentication.

evidence_findings.title: Authentication Pattern Analysis
evidence_findings.subject: m.alvarez
evidence_findings.evidence: The failed login was immediately followed by a successful MFA-confirmed login from the same user, device, and IP address within one minute. No other failures for this account were observed in the preceding 30 days.
evidence_findings.conclusion: This pattern is highly indicative of a user mistyping their password rather than a malicious brute-force attempt or compromise.
